hotspots.title: US Midterm Election Rout & MAGA Internal Backlash
hotspots.blurb: The Republican Party's crushing defeat in the 2026 midterm elections has ignited an intense civil war within the MAGA movement. Lawmakers and commentators are openly turning on Donald Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, pointing to the unpopular war in Iran and high inflation as the catalysts for losing both chambers of Congress. Meanwhile, figures like Vice President JD Vance and Marco Rubio are attempting to distance themselves or maneuver for 2028.
hotspots.affect: Commands extreme affective investment as right-wing media grapples with existential panic, high-stakes internal betrayals, and the sudden collapse of GOP congressional control.

hotspots.title: Polish Constitutional Court Crisis & Coup Accusations
hotspots.blurb: Tensions around Poland's Constitutional Tribunal (TK) have escalated into a full-scale political war between Law and Justice (PiS) and Donald Tusk's government. Jarosław Kaczyński has announced a special parliamentary team to investigate what he labels an illegal 'coup d'état', threatening those occupying the tribunal with up to life imprisonment. Meanwhile, President Karol Nawrocki's dramatic entry into the tribunal and clashes over SOP security protocols have further heightened institutional confrontation.
hotspots.affect: Generates intense affective charge through apocalyptic constitutional rhetoric, coup accusations, and threats of severe criminal retribution against state officials.

hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Following his defeat in the Brazilian presidential election, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has fled to the United States, declaring he will take details of his escape 'to the grave.' The drama has triggered sharp backlash, with US Democratic lawmakers demanding his immediate deportation and President Lula mocking his sudden departure. Meanwhile, internal squabbles among Bolsonarists worsen back home as the family's political capital rapidly deteriorates.
hotspots.affect: Drives high emotional charge surrounding secret escape narratives, international deportation demands, and the dramatic unraveling of the Bolsonarista movement.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei Madrid Visit & Vox Alliance
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei's visit to Madrid for the Ibero-American Summit produced sharp diplomatic friction, highlighted by a cold, formal handshake with Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. Milei utilized the platform to rail against left-wing policies, explicitly equating socialism with fascism during his address. His exclusive meetings with Vox leader Santiago Abascal reinforced transnational far-right solidarity while stirring controversies both in Spain and Argentina.
hotspots.affect: Draws intense interest due to fiery ideological speeches, public diplomatic hostility, and high-visibility populist alliance-building.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: The Rassemblement National is accelerating its long-term strategy for the 2027 presidential campaign amidst severe legal hurdles threatening Marine Le Pen's eligibility. Party president Jordan Bardella has launched a high-profile promotional campaign for his new book 'Gouverner', pushing hardline constitutional economic reforms despite media walkouts and sharp scrutiny over past party controversies. RN leadership continues to project confidence while attempting to position itself as a credible alternative to Macron's beleaguered administration.
hotspots.affect: Commands steady, focused media energy around high-stakes presidential maneuvering, legal existential threats, and media-confrontation drama.
